candidate_prior.definition: Ordinary queens plus zero, one or two D4 leaper orbits 1<=a<b<=11. No likelihood/prior weighting or true-orbit-count restriction.

hypothesis: The unchanged source-MAP-guided four-query policy identifies at least75percent of eligible truths SEPARATELY in each true orbit-count stratum0,1,2, on one new sixteen-positive source bank per truth.
primary: For each stratum require integer exact count >=ceil(3*n/4); all three stratum endpoints and overall conjunction retained. Exact means current consistent set equals true singleton. Every tie/no-information stop fails. k0 has one truth, not a population-rate estimate.
sampling: For each of all1511eligible truths draw16 distinct N12 valid boards uniformly without replacement with NumPy default_rng(2026120000+candidateID).choice(M,16,replace=False). All30M<16 truths remain ineligible, not successes/failures. One bank per truth; no seed search or additional retries.
policy: At each step choose current MAP guide, then among all unqueried ordinary-queen N13 boards maximize the NUMBER of current candidates predicting the opposite label from that guide. Lexicographically first board among all maxima. Every compatible candidate survives oracle answer, regardless of posterior weight. No repeated boards.
posterior: UNCHANGED H3au prior: P(k)=1/3 for k0/1/2, uniform among C(55,k) models. Sixteen distinct uniform positive examples have likelihood1/C(M,16) for consistent models. Current MAP minimizes exact integer C(55,k)*C(M,16) over all surviving candidates; common3 omitted. All MAP ties retained in receipt; smallest candidate ID guides query only.
initial_candidates: Exactly H3bc all1541 candidates filtered ONLY by16 positive N12 observations. No completeN12 class, no true complexity restriction, no empty-population filtering.
stopping: Stop unique or after4 queries. If no unqueried board has positive disagreement, retain all remaining identities and stop unresolved scientific failure, not numerical failure; no extra budget. Seal such terminal decision without oracle call.
supervision: New simulated draws from known finite source populations, not unseen populations or real-world label acquisition.16 positive N12 observations plus at most4 noiseless binary N13 labels; known finite candidate solver predictions. No complete-source class, true-complexity restriction or empty-model filtering.
controls: No new balanced/random control and no transfer of narrow-study paired improvement. Truth-scope generalization only. All prior sampled truth families may recur, but no new-bank outcomes have been inspected.
selector_isolation: Persistent separate selector process caches ONLY immutable packed predictions and fixed source scores. Every request fully supplies current candidateIDs and queried boards; no hidden per-case state, trueID or oracle access. Source-level interface isolation, not OS sandbox.

optimization.parity: Before ANY fresh draws, exactly replay all278 frozen H3bd query requests and require identical full selection dictionaries, including all MAP and board ties.
optimization.timing: On fixed first8 archived requests, time old one-shot selector including8 process startups versus8 warm persistent requests. Record persistent startup+first response separately. All overhead charged to study; no end-to-end speedup inferred from microbenchmark.

sealing: Source score table and runtime parity receipt precede every new source draw. Seal each source draw/filter before queries. Fsync read-only query receipt before oracle; answer hash reference and later timestamps. Preserve no-information terminal receipt without answer.
prediction_reuse: Hash-pin complete H3bc packed populations and successful independent full literal audit, preserving its coverage boundary. Fresh whole1541 graph-filter parity and metadata/cardinality/hash checks; no duplicate literal enumeration in this study. Prior full literal proof is inherited, not newly measured.

budget.enforcement: Whole-study cap includes all source draws, full parity, optimization parity/timing and every eligible case; cap/error incomplete without pruning. Public audit separate.
